meaning: The One who has abundance of mercy for all creation.
sampleDuaArabic: يَا رَحْمَٰنُ، ارْحَمْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
sampleDuaTrans: Ya Rahmanu, irhamni bi-rahmatikal-lati wasi'at kulla shay'in.
sampleDuaEng: O Most Gracious, encompass me in Your mercy that embraces all creation.
